verdict.rationale: Diagnosing GPU-acceleration fallback is a fair question for a local LLM runner, but the evidence pack shows no documented diagnostic output explaining why GPU offload failed or fell back to CPU. The `lms load --gpu` flag is only an adjacent offload control, not diagnostics. A community report of models failing to load with no error feedback points the other way, though it concerns a macOS version issue rather than GPU fallback.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
